# Embryo

> Embryo is a full-service digital marketing agency in Manchester offering proprietary intelligence tools and integrated marketing services across SEO, PPC, paid social, affiliate marketing, digital PR, and web design.

Embryo combines award-winning agency services with proprietary Supertools (Needle, Intermingle, Custerdome, and Bardo) that provide competitive intelligence, SERP tracking, audience insights, and paid media optimization. The agency specializes in organic search, paid advertising, and performance marketing for e-commerce and enterprise clients.

## Key Topics

- Supertools
- Needle (organic search insights)
- Intermingle (SERP intelligence)
- Custerdome (audience insights)
- Bardo (paid media optimization)
- SEO
- PPC & Google Ads
- Paid Social
- Affiliate Marketing

## Proprietary Tools (Supertools)

- [Supertools](https://embryo.com/supertools): Embryo Supertools suite: Needle, Intermingle, Bardo, Custerdome platforms
- [Needle](https://embryo.com/supertools/needle): Needle: organic search insights tool for competitive and industry analysis
- [Intermingle](https://embryo.com/supertools/intermingle): Intermingle: SERP intelligence tool for competitor tracking and ranking
- [Custerdome](https://embryo.com/supertools/custerdome): Custerdome: AI-powered audience insights for media planning and trends
- [Bardo](https://embryo.com/supertools/bardo): Bardo: proprietary paid media optimization tool for e-commerce performance

## Core Services

- [SEO](https://embryo.com/seo): Embryo SEO services: Manchester-based agency for organic search optimization
- [PPC](https://embryo.com/ppc): Embryo PPC: Google Ads, Shopping, Performance Max specialists
- [Paid Social](https://embryo.com/paid-social): Embryo Paid Social: Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest advertising
- [Affiliate Marketing](https://embryo.com/affiliate-marketing): Embryo Affiliate Marketing: recruitment, management, performance campaigns
- [Digital PR](https://embryo.com/digital-pr-agency): Embryo Digital PR: campaigns for brand awareness and backlink building
- [Web Design](https://embryo.com/web-design): Embryo Web Design: UX-focused sites with CRO and conversion optimization
